qualifier: in both meiosis and mitosis, with meiotic recombination
name: Meiotic and mitotic chromosome cohesion, condensation and segregation
rationale: Members cover sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation, centromere/CENP-A assembly and segregation in mitosis and meiosis; unlike the confusables (nuclear envelope, cytokinesis, APC/C, centrosome) the theme includes meiotic recombination, synapsis and meiotic division.

qualifier: replication, capping and t-loop/D-loop processing
name: Telomere maintenance by replication, capping and D-loop resolution
rationale: All members concern telomere end maintenance; the theme has semi-conservative telomere replication, positive capping/packaging and t-circle/D-loop handling, whereas confusables emphasise recombination-based maintenance, negative capping and NHEJ protection.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
name: Pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members span de novo, salvage and catabolic routes of pyrimidine (U/C/T) nucleotides and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, distinguishing it from confusables centred on purine de novo synthesis, purine deoxynucleoside defects or NDP/NTP interconversion.

qualifier: collagen and elastin degradation by metalloproteinases
name: Metalloproteinase-driven collagen and elastin degradation
rationale: Members share breakdown of matrix proteins (collagen, elastin) via MMP activation and endopeptidase regulation, unlike confusables about fibrinolysis/coagulation proteolysis or ECM assembly and collagen synthesis.

qualifier: epithelial lineages and ductal branching
name: Mammary epithelial lineages and ductal branching morphogenesis
rationale: All members are mammary development; the theme has stem, luminal, myoepithelial and alveolar lineages plus duct branching and thelarche, while confusables cover lactation and alveolar differentiation or prostate/genital development.

qualifier: responses to endogenous danger ligands with SIRP restraint
name: Monocyte inflammatory response to endogenous danger signals
rationale: Members describe myeloid/monocyte inflammatory signaling triggered by endogenous ligands (oxidised LDL, heme, endogenous TLR ligands) and restrained via SIRP and inhibition of phagocytosis/neutrophil activation, unlike confusables on microbial LPS/TLR2 sensing or Fc-receptor and neutrophil effector functions.

qualifier: oncogene, replicative and stress-induced, with heterochromatin and Polycomb silencing
name: Oncogene, replicative and stress-induced senescence with heterochromatin silencing
rationale: All members concern induction and regulation of cellular senescence; the theme adds SAHF/subtelomeric heterochromatin and BMI1 Polycomb silencing plus SASP, whereas confusables centre on p53 apoptotic control or cancer evasion of senescence via p16/p14ARF defects.

qualifier: transferrin cycle and endosomal iron export
name: Transferrin-mediated iron uptake and endosomal recycling
rationale: Members describe the transferrin endocytic cycle and DMT1 (SLC11A2)-dependent iron release, distinct from confusables on general iron homeostasis, heme scavenging or copper/manganese transport.

qualifier: oxidation and N-acetylation of amines and phytochemicals
name: Xenobiotic oxidation and N-acetylation of amines and phytochemicals
rationale: Members cover detoxification of foreign compounds including alkaloids, terpenoids, phenylpropanoids and aromatic amines by CYP oxidation/demethylation and acetylation, unlike confusables featuring sulfonation, methylation, FMO oxidation or specific drug ADME.

qualifier: Sema4D in migration and growth-cone collapse
name: Sema4D-plexin signaling in cell migration and growth-cone collapse
rationale: All members concern semaphorin-plexin signaling, specifically Sema4D effects on attachment, migration and growth-cone collapse via RND1, unlike confusables on Sema3A axon repulsion, ephrins or G12/13-Rho signaling.

qualifier: via mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition
name: Metanephric nephron epithelial differentiation via mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition
rationale: Members concern epithelial differentiation of metanephric nephron tubules and the regulating MET, distinct from confusables on nephron segment morphogenesis (comma/S-shaped bodies) or ureteric bud and duct development.

qualifier: combined T and B cell, with B cell differentiation
name: Combined T and B lymphocyte development and activation
rationale: Members span both T cell (thymocyte, costimulation, differentiation) and B cell (differentiation, proliferation) development and activation, whereas confusables are T-cell-only activation, early B lineage commitment or mature B cell modules.

qualifier: POLH error-free translesion and NER gap filling
name: Error-free POLH translesion synthesis and NER gap filling
rationale: Members share DNA polymerase-driven repair synthesis: POLH error-free lesion bypass and gap-filling/ligation in nucleotide excision repair, unlike confusables on error-prone TLS polymerases, base excision repair or NER damage recognition and incision.

qualifier: fibronectin matrix and SRF-driven stress fibres in fibroblasts
name: Fibronectin-integrin-syndecan adhesion driving stress fibres and fibroblast migration
rationale: Members link fibronectin matrix, integrin/syndecan adhesion and SRF-dependent cytoskeletal remodeling to stress fibres and fibroblast migration, distinguishing from confusables on ROCK/PAK signaling, invadopodia, MET-PTK2 or focal adhesion assembly.

qualifier: kinesin and Miro transport of mitochondria and neuronal vesicles
name: Microtubule motor transport of mitochondria, vesicles and neuronal cargo
rationale: Members describe motor-driven organelle and cargo transport (kinesins, RHOT/Miro mitochondrial distribution, axo-dendritic vesicle and receptor transport), unlike confusables on tubulin modification, ER tubule shaping or clathrin/vesicle cycling.

qualifier: to UV, nitric oxide and mitogen stimuli
name: AP-1 immediate-early response to UV, nitric oxide and mitogens
rationale: Members share induction of AP-1/FOS-family and NR4A immediate-early genes by UV, nitric oxide, phorbol ester, KRAS/PI3K and TNF signals, whereas confusables focus on upstream TAK1-JNK/p38 kinase regulation, ERK feedback or monocyte chemokines.

qualifier: ribbon disassembly, reassembly and positioning
name: Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and positioning
rationale: All members concern Golgi architecture: ribbon formation, mitotic disassembly/reassembly and pericentriolar localization, unlike confusables on Golgi vesicle budding, intra-Golgi traffic or unrelated GTPase cycles.

core: Thyroid hormone and amino acid transport
qualifier: iodide and neutral amino acid carriers
name: Thyroid hormone, iodide and neutral amino acid transport
rationale: Members cover membrane transport of thyroid hormone and iodide (NIS) and of neutral amino acids (leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine, glutamine, alanine), distinguishing it from confusables on cationic amino acid, polyamine or inositol transport.

qualifier: AIM2 and NLRC4 (IPAF) inflammasomes
name: Pyroptosis via AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasomes
rationale: Members share inflammasome-driven pyroptotic cell death through AIM2 and IPAF/NLRC4, unlike confusables centred on NLRP1/NLRP3 IL-1 processing or non-canonical CASP4/5 inflammasomes.

qualifier: activated by Rho GTPases via WASP/WAVE for lamellipodia
name: Rho GTPase-WASP/WAVE activation of Arp2/3 lamellipodial actin
rationale: All three members describe Rho GTPase activation of WASP/WAVE driving Arp2/3 actin nucleation and lamellipodia, unlike confusables on phagocytic cup formation, general leading-edge polymerisation or RAC GTPase cycles.

qualifier: deadenylation-dependent decay at maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Deadenylation-dependent maternal mRNA decay at maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members concern poly(A) shortening and deadenylation-dependent decay (P-bodies) with maternal mRNA M- and Z-decay at MZT, unlike confusables on ARE/miRNA-mediated decay, nuclear RNA surveillance or zygotic genome activation and piRNA.

qualifier: intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and metanephric mesenchyme
name: Early kidney development from intermediate mesoderm to renal vesicle
rationale: Members span intermediate mesoderm, pronephros, nephric duct, ureteric bud elongation, metanephric mesenchyme maintenance and MET to renal vesicles, whereas confusables cover later S-shaped body nephron morphogenesis or negative regulation of kidney growth.

qualifier: brown and beige fat differentiation and cold-induced thermogenesis
name: Brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis
rationale: Members concern brown/beige fat differentiation (EBF2, PGC-1alpha), cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis and associated fatty acid cycling/transport, unlike confusables on white adipogenesis, lipogenic transcription or lipid droplet/triglyceride storage.

qualifier: lipase-mediated remodeling and clearance
name: Lipase-mediated plasma lipoprotein remodeling and clearance
rationale: Members cover LPL/LIPC lipase activation and remodeling and clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL with triglyceride catabolism, unlike confusables on intestinal lipid absorption, lipoprotein assembly or negative lipolysis regulation.

qualifier: astrocyte and oligodendrocyte fate, proliferation and gliosis
name: Glial cell fate, proliferation, gliosis and myelination
rationale: Members concern glial specification, proliferation, astrocyte activation/gliosis and CNS/PNS myelination with axon calibre, unlike confusables on nodal/paranodal assembly or axon sprouting and regeneration.
